title: [Used] HP EliteBook 830 G8 Intel i7 1185G7 16GB RAM 512GB SSD Win 11 $250 Delivered @ Australian Computer Traders
body:
Deal: [Used] HP EliteBook 830 G8 Intel i7 1185G7 16GB RAM 512GB SSD Win 11 $250 Delivered @ Australian Computer Traders

[alz] Pretty good
Already got two of them 1 for a year 7 kid and another one for the Mrs
[Chivalry] do folks generally get the extended warranty on refurbed units?
[knk] It's almost like even you don't think it's worth it lmao
[Zex94] Does anyone know if this is the touchscreen variant?
[Brisbane1] No this is just standard screen touch ones are x360 model
[bargaino] Easy and cheap to replace the dead battery on these.
Also can upgrade the ddr4 sodimm and SSD. So add another 16GB - what can it cost, $10?
[bargaino] I don't criticize you. And if that's a veiled criticism about me, I won't hear it and I won't respond to it.
[BrotherEstapol] Down-voters don't know their Arrested Development quotes!
[spaij] Austrian Oak was expressing the opinion, or perhaps, fact that 16GB can't be had for just $10. It's gone up in price over the last little while.
Ironically, you can ask AI to explain it to you, but that may push up RAM prices more…
[sween64] Battery replacement
$75 + shipping for the battery
[Ehx] Can get them for under 40 bucks on aliexpress
[supersabroso] @tc43: Yeah, if there's one thing we've learnt it's not to buy el cheapo lithium batteries. However, the slow discharge/charge ones seems OK, it's the fast charge/discharge ones like the e-bike batteries that are all going up in flames.
[Megatron] Does it say anywhere as to how old they are?
If they are 5 year old, they would mostly be EOL anyways. My last work HP that was well loaded had severe issues past 4 years.
[pq8382] I believe for premium business line hp usually hold okay even at 5 years mark?
[deebee8] If it is anything like my one - yes it is a single 16gb stick
[godofpizza] as long as they don't ship it like they did with the mouses recently.

can't blame em honestly

What did you think would happen to a mouse during transit?

[pq8382] Awsome deal, consider the ssd price now day..The 512g ssd is great vaule
[bluemyself] From their website:
What Do the Grades Mean?
We offer two grades to help you choose the right laptop for your needs and budget:
Grade A: Great condition – minor signs of wear, fully functional.
Grade B: Good condition – moderate cosmetic wear.
There's more info on the website, but that's the gist.
[SetTheFaqUp] My own laptop has cosmetic wear too. Doesn't say much, really.
[philsw] I got one of the A grade ones for daughter for school. Only issues is the battery doesn't last the full day unless you are in power save mode the whole day and don't do anything too taxing.

Dell OptiPlex 7070 Micro Intel i5 9500T 2.20GHz 16GB RAM 256GB SSD Wi-Fi Win 11

Not the cheapest, but fairly decent. Good luck if you get it.
Edit: It's OOS now
[dealhunting007] Great price got one. ACT is highly recommended,bought few laptop from them in past and always had great experience.
[deebee8] I have used these for work in the past - they are great little machines. Very easy to handle and lights enough for me.
The bodies are a bit weak, dropped mine while i was on the couch height and it bent the corner.
Very easy to repair and get to any parts.
Hope these have a unlocked bios as mine had the FN lock on all the time and could only be turned off from the bios.
They are on the noisy side, for no reason at all it would turn up its fans to 100% when not under any load.
[King Tightarse] How was the screen? There are some comments suggesting the screen is crap?
[deebee8] Screen is good enough- nothing special but not crap. For the price it punches above its weight
